Changes in `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/GsonBuilder.java`:
- `registerTypeAdapter` (gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/GsonBuilder.java:675) now throws `IllegalArgumentException("Cannot override built-in adapter for " + type)` when the type is `Object` or a `JsonElement` subclass.
- `registerTypeHierarchyAdapter` (gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/GsonBuilder.java:736) throws the same exception when the base type is a `JsonElement` subclass (registering a hierarchy adapter for `Object` remains allowed, per the tests).
- Javadoc for both methods extended to document this restriction and mention `@JsonAdapter` as a workaround.
